deliverables.description: Every required RU, EN and IT route is accounted for without orphaned or silently removed pages.
All Russian inner pages use the approved homepage design system before EN and IT synchronization.
The approved full-site direction is implemented as a bounded runnable build.
Routes, metadata, internal linking and applicable structured data are verified for the multilingual surface.
Representative and critical routes are verified on desktop and mobile without overflow, clipping or broken alignment.
A real local preview passes functional, visual and technical checks for the delivered route set.

A black-and-pink authorial system, approved geometric mark, protected reading zones and dense microtypographic glyph interaction form one non-generic visual system without fake HUD copy, LED dots or dominant glassmorphism.
KZMS, ENDOkey, POVKH LAB and Giulia Povkh retain complete factual copy and high-quality real media.
Homepage drag rotation and soft glyph-field alignment are optional, polished, progressive-enhancement safe and reduced-motion safe; inner pages use restrained static derivatives.
RU is approved first; EN and IT are then synchronized without deleting or degrading either locale.
No stray line, overlap, clipping, sharp unintended card, misaligned marker or degraded case image remains.
